page.layout: One printed page. Running title and heading at full width at top; below, one column of text with a woodcut initial; marginal notes in the right margin (handwritten-looking marginalia and a catchword-like note at right); page signature and page number at foot.

main_text.head: IACOBICE PORINI COMPENDIVM Grammaticae Graecae.
main_text.p: LITERAE Graecae sunt, α. β. γ. δ. ε. ζ. η. θ. ι. κ. λ. μ. ν. ξ. ο. π. ρ. σ. τ. υ. φ. χ. ψ. ω.
main_text.head: De Vocalibus.
main_text.p: Vocales logae, η. ω. Breues, ε. ο. Nunc logae, nunc breues, α. ι. υ. Mutabiles, α. ε. ο. et α. ε. in η quidem transeunt, ο uero in ω.
main_text.head: De Diphthongis.
main_text.p: Diphthongi propriae, αι. αω. ει. ευ. οι. ου. Diphthongi Impropriae, α. η. ῳ. ηυ. υι. puncto subtus i gi. signate, & una Ionum propria ωυ, ut ὠὐτός pro αὐτός.
main_text.head: De Consonantibus & earum diuisione.
main_text.p: Consonantes mutabiles, mutę, & sibi inuicem oppositae, tenues, κ. π. τ. medię, γ. β. δ. densę, χ. φ. θ. Immutabiles, & liquidae, λ. μ. ν. ρ. Duplices, ζ. ξ. ψ. quarum ζ ex σσ uel δσ, ξ ex κσ γσ uel χσ, ψ ex πσ βσ uel φσ analogice conficiuntur.

page.notes: The marginal annotations are handwritten (manuscript marginalia) and are not transcribed as printed text except where noted; Greek letters are reproduced as best legible. Right-margin manuscript notes ("a limende", "Litere", "Consonan tes", "ordo") and the bracketed Greek combinations at right are marginal/handwritten and uncertain. Some Greek forms in the sound lists may be imperfectly read; the Greek accents on ὠὐτός/αὐτός are uncertain.
